summary: Iteration 2 (refactor): tested new access-control model (time-ranges, holidays, areas, controllers, access-points, categories), org, cadastros, simulator, menu/sidebar, favorites, config hub and RBAC. New backend tests: 23/23 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_access_model.py (plus the 12 pre-existing engine unit tests). Admin login + sidebar + Ctrl+K search palette + CRUD pages (faixas-horarias 2 rows incl Livre+Comercial, feriados 2, areas 8 w/ EXTERIOR, pontos-acesso 6, empresas 4, departamentos 5) + category edit tabs (Dados gerais w/ impeditive flag, Áreas de acesso, Pessoas associadas) + Configurações hub (6 cards) + Logs (acessos & sincronização) + viewer RBAC (Configurações group hidden, no crud-add, no category-edit) all work. Controller test/sync works and sync-job summary shows TZ:2 Áreas:8 Pontos:2 Regras:6 Pessoas:40/40. BLOCKED simulator correctly returns 'Pessoa inativa/bloqueada'. BUT the headline GRANTED simulator scenario FAILS: an active funcionario on 'Catraca Pedestre - Entrada' at 10:00 BRT returns DENIED 'Origem inválida' because seed sets person.current_area_id to EXTERIOR (global, is_exterior=true) while the entry turnstile origin_area_id is 'Área Externa Pedestre'; PEDESTRE category has control_origin=true so engine step rejects. Additionally, two legacy endpoints are broken by the refactor (/reports/occupancy and /emergency/muster both 500 due to area['name'] but new areas use area['description']); /structure/doors and /devices now return empty arrays (collections replaced).

critical.issue: GRANTED scenario fails. Active funcionario (person_type=funcionario, status=ativo, category PEDESTRE) simulating 'Catraca Pedestre - Entrada' at Tue 10:00 BRT returns denied with reason 'Origem inválida'. Root cause: seed sets person.current_area_id = EXTERIOR (is_exterior=true, id different from the AP origin 'Área Externa Pedestre'); PEDESTRE category has control_origin=true. Either (a) seed must set funcionarios' current_area_id to 'Área Externa Pedestre' (and vehicles/trucks to their respective external areas), or (b) entry AP origins must be the global EXTERIOR area, or (c) engine should treat is_exterior areas as compatible with any 'external' origin. This is the core deliverable scenario per the playbook.

Returns 500 — code reads area['name'] but new areas model stores 'description'. Breaks /ocupacao page (console shows two 500s). Fix: use area.get('description') (and area.get('is_exterior') to skip or include EXTERIOR).
Returns 500 — same area['name'] vs 'description' regression. Breaks Emergência screen 'muster report'.

minor.issue: Returns empty array; refactor moved doors to /equipment/access-points. Either alias to access_points or remove the endpoint to avoid dead API surface.
Returns empty array; refactor moved devices to /equipment/controllers. Same cleanup needed.

ui_bugs.issue: Hovering a nav item (e.g., [data-testid=nav-dashboard]) does not reveal any [data-testid^='fav-star-'] element — count is 0. Playbook requires star-on-hover to pin to Favoritos. Likely either the star is not rendered at all, or the testid prefix differs. Investigate Layout.jsx NavItem for the favorite button rendering.

Console warning on every page open: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible'. Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle (or an explicit one) to the command-palette Dialog and any other DialogContent missing a title.

Expected testid 'group-Portaria' not found — the group label is actually 'Portaria / Recepção' so the testid becomes 'group-Portaria / Recepção'. Not a bug, but the slash in a testid is fragile; consider slugging the testid (e.g., group-portaria-recepcao).

integration_issues.issue: Page relies on GET /reports/occupancy which returns 500 (see backend issue). Cards never render; EXTERIOR not visible.

action_items: Fix GRANTED simulator path: align seed so funcionarios/vehicles/trucks have current_area_id matching the origin of their respective entry access points (or make entry APs originate from the global EXTERIOR area). Then re-run /api/access/simulate for an active funcionario on 'Catraca Pedestre - Entrada' at commercial hours — must return granted:true.

Fix /api/reports/occupancy and /api/emergency/muster: replace area['name'] with area['description'] in routers/dashboard.py and routers/events.py, and consider skipping is_exterior areas in the muster/occupancy outputs.

Investigate favorites: ensure hover on NavItem shows a button with data-testid starting 'fav-star-' and that clicking it persists under localStorage 'nx_favorites' and renders a 'Favoritos' group at the top.
Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden) to the command-palette Dialog to silence a11y warning.
Clean up legacy endpoints /api/structure/doors and /api/devices (either remove or redirect to the new equipment collections).
critical_code_review_comments: Routers/dashboard.py occupancy_report and routers/events.py muster_report still use the old area['name'] field — breaks the whole page/screen without a graceful fallback.
crud.py uses MongoDB regex $regex with the raw user query string — potential ReDoS/injection surface. Consider re.escape on q before building $regex.

equipment.py sync_controller inserts a dict directly (dict(job) before cleaning _id); ok, but the function is long (~45 lines) and mixes driver IO, DB persistence, and audit — split into service helpers.
No consistent error contract from decision engine: evaluate() returns {granted: bool, reason, steps, ...} but tests may expect access_result; document the response shape in a Pydantic response_model.

Seed is not fully consistent: current_area_id of all people is set to the global EXTERIOR, but control_origin categories require origin to match the AP's non-exterior external area. Either seed must initialise each person at the correct external area or control_origin logic should treat any is_exterior area as valid origin for entry APs.

rca of the issue: Simulator GRANTED path: in seed.py, every person's current_area_id defaults to the global EXTERIOR area id (is_exterior=true). But in the access-point graph, the Catraca Pedestre - Entrada has origin_area_id = 'Área Externa Pedestre' (is_exterior=false). The PEDESTRE category (assigned to funcionarios) has control_origin=true, so engine.decide() rejects at step 108-111: `if person.current_area_id != ap.origin_area_id -> deny('Origem inválida')`. Fix the seed to set current_area_id per person_type (funcionarios→Área Externa Pedestre, vehicles→Área Externa Veículos, caminhões→Área Externa Caminhões) OR relax engine.decide() so that is_exterior areas are considered compatible with any 'external' origin when the AP is of direction='entrada'. Reproduction: GET /api/people?limit=200 → pick first person_type=funcionario, status=ativo; GET /api/equipment/access-points/all → pick description containing 'Catraca Pedestre' and direction='entrada'; POST /api/access/simulate {person_id, access_point_id, datetime:'2026-01-13T10:00:00-03:00'} → expected granted=true, actual granted=false, reason='Origem inválida'.
